install_configuration.reason: Otherwise req_llm loads a .env file from the working directory when its application starts under Mix.

contract: Anthropic Messages API provider of integration/ai-text through req_llm 1.30's documented provider-callback API: anthropic-version 2026-10-21, max_retries 0, one HTTP exchange with every response halted by an Elzoo step (no redirect, no retry, no req_llm error value); key only from the injected Need as api_key; sampling not declared; structured output through output_config.format; cache hint mapped to cache_control markers (system and tools, at most one message, 5m or 1h) or refused; usage and cache counters from the raw usage map with absent fields :unknown; documented error statuses mapped to the interface's failure tags.
limits: Stub evidence only (R5): conformance to the pinned documented format, never current live behaviour, cache hits or savings, output quality, latency or rate limits; a periodic live check is a later owner decision.

Requests are validated against a schema hand-derived from named sections of Anthropic's documentation fetched 2026-11-09; no official machine-readable specification was found; conformance beyond the documented examples is not claimed.
req_llm accepts anthropic-version 2026-10-21 only as a header override; compatibility of its encoder with that version rests on the listed schema-validated scenarios.
Sampling, structured output together with tools, provider-executed tools, image and document input, streaming and batch are refused or not supplied in this slice.
Tenants sharing one Anthropic key share Anthropic's prompt cache; configure one credential per tenant where isolation matters.

Every consumer must merge config :req_llm, load_dotenv: false into its configuration: the line is declared in install_configuration and written into the generated install file, but the copier never edits a consumer's configuration. The repository's copied-consumer harness writes the line and checks that it is set before req_llm starts in the aggregate consumer; a hand-copied consumer that drops the line is not checked. The credential invariant holds regardless: only the injected key is used.

grounding.claim: Every captured stub request is validated with jsv against this schema hand-derived from Anthropic's Messages API reference, Prompt caching, Versions and Migrating to API version 2026-10-21 (fetched 2026-11-09), plus method, path, the pinned version header, the injected key and absent sampling fields. Not an official specification; conformance beyond the documented examples is not claimed.

Listed scenarios against in-process function-plug stubs in Anthropic's documented formats: the interface conformance kit; usage and cache counters (cold write, warm read, mixed TTL, below minimum, absent fields, partial breakdowns, disagreeing totals); tool-result error flag on the wire; cache-hint and reasoning translation and refusals before any request; documented error statuses and a redirect with one request each; transport timeout with one request; malformed 2xx; redaction in results, inspect, owner state, debug logs and req_llm telemetry; ambient keys never used across a req_llm restart with a .env file; source audit of this Piece's own manifest-listed files; the README's Install configuration section carries the exact config line. Finite scenarios, no live call, not proofs.

req_llm 1.30.0 (Hex checksum 1c4b19608aa982de5ea396cc6de3d3738e72480182ba11c184e028a4af305edb) Anthropic request encoding, model resolution, authentication and version headers and the documented provider-callback API prepare_request/4 plus Req.request/1; observations of the pinned version (probe transcripts in the task work record), not guarantees.
llm_db 2026.11.0 model metadata used by req_llm for model resolution and reasoning encoding.
Req 0.7.5 response and error steps, Req.Request.halt/2 and the :plug test transport.
Anthropic's live API behaves as its documentation describes; a 429 or 529 meaning 'before generation' is named only and authorizes nothing; the host keeps the key Need truthful.

telemetry.contract: No Elzoo event. req_llm may emit its request start event (payload capture off by default) to consumer-installed handlers; response-side events are not emitted because every response is halted. Own events through runtime/telemetry: future task.

config.contract: Construction-time provider term (optional HTTPS base URL; a test plug), fixed API version 2026-10-21, max_retries 0, receive timeout from the interface Config, key from the injected Need; no hot reconfiguration.

control.contract: Call-scoped; dispatch, rearm and expiry are the delivery/effect-intent owner's Control.
